title: The renderer's own life: made (async), live, destroyed, rebuilt
oneLine: Pixi renderer birth (qa delay, picture restores, app.init), live use, destroy, rebuild by canvas epoch; module-level handles.
topConcern: A cleanup during a pending init destroys nothing; the stale init later assigns itself, leaking a WebGL context or drawing to a detached canvas.

title: The WebGL context: asked for, lost, restored, judged on a tab's return
oneLine: Context loss/restore stamps, depth-buffer patch, no-stencil latch, and the tab-return keep-or-rebuild-ground decision.
topConcern: createPixiApp's loss listener lacks crashTrap's isConnected test, so each rebuild teardown logs a synthetic gl-context-lost into the crash ring.

title: One frame's passes: the camera on whole device pixels, your place lent to the draw
oneLine: update() shifts S.player by a sub-pixel for the world passes and restores it; throw-once latches; pool sweep clock.
topConcern: One unwrapped silhouettes.clear() between shift and restore could leave the player shifted; practically unreachable.

title: A world that will not draw: the render-throw streak, the heal, the one rebuild
oneLine: Counts consecutive throwing frames (app.render and update) and asks for one rebuild exactly at the 90th.
topConcern: A 90th throw inside the 5 s rebuild window is dropped (a throw is not a loss) and never asked again; only the watchdog recovers.

title: The renderer's zone: which world-holders exist, cleared on every zone or map swap
oneLine: onZoneChange observes zone/map identity and owns one-at-a-time Wheel objects, farm and arena holders plus clears.
topConcern: Holders are made only on the zone-change edge; a same-zone map swap reruns the full entry clear.

title: The loading-screen gate: global pictures loaded, baked, uploaded
oneLine: preloadPlayerAssets pipeline: wave 1, wave 2, mask bake, alt sets, GPU uploads, program warms; report and QA steps.
topConcern: __btPreloadReport can never say rejected (groups are caught before allSettled), so QA 'fulfilled' checks are vacuous; no per-group timeout.

title: A zone's own art: loaded behind its loading screen, freed a beat after you leave
oneLine: preloadZoneAssets/freeZoneAssets with a 400 ms deferred free against the destination named at scheduling time.
topConcern: A death in the Wheel frees its art 400 ms out; the town stop returns after a 400 ms settle; order holds by one frame.

title: A zone banner's strip: cold, warming, held, let go
oneLine: Per-theme decoded banner strip held in a Map with in-flight dedupe and a cache-only ready gate.
topConcern: freeZoneBanner skips a theme still in flight; the warm then lands and holds the strip for a zone already left.

title: The DOM pictures warmed on the gate and held for the page
oneLine: Seven warm-decode-hold modules (controls, cue, XP bar, quest art, level-up, stat demo, chest); only chest memoised.
topConcern: Each rejoin without reload re-bakes the blue slime into new unrevoked blob URLs and holds ~2.4 MB more decoded strips.

title: The ground under a zone: which ground is live, and the map put off for today's town
oneLine: TileRenderer picks one of six grounds per rebuild, with deferred town map, post-rebuild reloads, label pool and memos.
topConcern: Zone-label Text pool is hidden, never destroyed or emptied (TRAPS §192); _forceImageReload outlived its ImageBitmap reason.

title: The zones' minimap box: shown, held back, handed to the Wheel's box
oneLine: 52 px box visibility (zone loading, Wheel hand-over) with memo keys for land, exits, party rims, rail inset.
topConcern: Rail inset re-measured only on a canvas-height change; door tiles kept in three hand copies.

title: The Wheel's minimap: per-map build, town pictures held and freed, clock of land-crossing notes
oneLine: Wheel box build/scale/town-icon holds, and the only caller of land banner, No man's land and land-music notes.
topConcern: resetWheelMusic is unreachable, so after a death BroTown plays the death land's track ~8 s; notes freeze whenever the box stops.

title: The maps' ambient life: per-zone glows and pooled drifting particles
oneLine: Zone config, persistent glows and age-driven pooled particles; plays only on retired old-map zones.
topConcern: No destroy and an untrimmed pool, bounded by caps; idle in the Wheel.

title: The dev frame-rate overlay
oneLine: ?dev=1 DOM overlay: 5-minute frame history, 250 ms redraw throttle, console summaries.
topConcern: Fed Date.now() though it assumes a monotonic clock; destroy deletes globals without an owner check.

title: A monster move's warning, drawn: lane, fan, ring, two rings, a ring that follows
oneLine: Drawing half of S._telegraphZones (created by gameEvents, aged out by effectsRenderer) by move shape.
topConcern: The follow shape writes tz.x/tz.y from the renderer; harmless while nothing else reads an entry.
